description: Appwrite shared Renovate preset. Renovate owns dependency PRs; Dependabot only raises alerts.

packageRules.description: Tags look like php-8.5-2.1.4, which Docker versioning rejects, so the image would never update.
A floating base image such as debian:trixie-slim gets OS fixes under the same tag, so only a digest shows that a rebuild is due.
Keep base image digest refreshes to one PR per repository.
Pins, digest refreshes and lock file maintenance change no code and have no release date, so the release age check would hold them forever.
GHCR and some other registries publish no release timestamps, so a docker update from them would wait on the release age check forever; check the age only where a timestamp exists.
Lock file maintenance carries the transitive fixes, so it goes ahead of the version update PRs the hourly limit would otherwise let through first.
